newsitem.title: GREECE: Delta Informatics says H1 pretax up 21.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Delta Informatics says H1 pretax up 21.5 pct.

text.p: Greek information technology listing Delta Informatics said in a statement that its half-year pretax profit rose provisionally 21.5 percent year-on-year to 650 million drachmas.
Turnover grew 43.7 percent to 2.285 billion drachmas over the same period, it said.

"The announced figures are provisional but they will not differ substantially from the official half-year financial statements which will be released shortly," Delta Informatics' financial director Yiannis Vlachos told Reuters.
Delta Informatics completed a rights issue of one new share per nine outstanding at 3,000 drachmas, raising 1.5 billion drachmas on July 11, 1997. The company said the rights issue was fully covered.
